messages.text: Accounts payable needs one defensible decision for supplier invoice INV-0041 by 2026-01-15; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside supplier, PO line, receipt, currency, tax, and tolerance must reconcile.
I found 13127.25 USD on the header, but the workbook has separate observation and exclusion rows. Please do not net from this message.

Protected load remains non-displaceable. The calendar for open accounting and payment cycle is the source for internal windows; the supplier response covers only its stated alternative.
